crime: Over weeks in the courtyard, a girl learned to answer {WITCH_NAME}'s imitation of a birdcall until it became their duet.

Today in the dining hall, the girl parodied that same call, and the prisoners laughed. {WITCH_NAME} ordered her to stop at once. The girl defied her by leading the prisoners in a mocking chorus of the birdcall.

That night, a guard locked the prisoners behind the barred cell door. {WITCH_NAME} gathered the stone cell wall beside the lower bunk into folds and stepped through the opening. She slashed the sleeping girl's throat with a sword and left her bleeding to death. After withdrawing into the cell corridor, she drew the wall shut, restoring the stone surface.

At morning unlock, the cell appeared sealed, and the prisoners accused the girl's roommate, who seemed to be the only person with access. Then one prisoner found a bloodstained corner of the bedsheet pinched in the stone wall on the corridor side and traced the same continuous fabric back to the cell bedding. The trapped sheet revealed that {WITCH_NAME} had used the wall as a hidden passage.
fields.epitaph: Obedience replaced companionship, leaving her with an audience but no company.
fields.epithet: The Queen of an Empty Court
execution: The execution stand clamped her neck across a sill beneath a raised, pleated steel curtain. The curtain dropped shut, its bladed hem shearing through her neck. When the steel curtain rose from the neck restraint, her body remained motionless on the stand.

magic.name: Parting Walls
magic.text: She can gather solid barriers into curtain folds, opening them and drawing them shut again.
